name: Server Reload Main
brief: Extends SRW Item with a validated field, arriving only on a --server bundle reload.
description: Cross-request half of server-reload (issue #1860). Adds a tableextension with an OnValidate field trigger to a table already loaded (base-only, no extension) by an earlier --server runTests request in the same session. Proves the trigger fires despite the wired-tables guard having recorded the table as done before this extension existed.
